title: [Bug][SubscriptionBilling] Process Usage Data Billing uses lines marked Processing Status = Error (currency mismatch)
summary: Process Usage Data Billing now excludes lines marked with Processing Status Error, preventing recalculation of erroneous data and consolidating filtering logic into a single helper method. Processing Status is now properly maintained throughout the billing workflow and users can manually close or reopen usage data imports.
key_points: Lines with Processing Status Error are now excluded from sums and lookups in the billing process
Three duplicate CalcSums procedures consolidated into one CalculateSumsFromUsageDataBilling method
Processing Status transitions now route through Validate to consistently stamp Processing Date
Manual Close/Reopen actions added to Usage Data Imports page with multi-select support
Six new tests added covering the corrected behavior
